data.name: Naghma
data.gender_notes: Naghma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'naghama', meaning 'to recite' or 'to chant'. The name Naghma symbolizes the sweet sound of recitation of the Quran or the melodic voice of a beloved. The name Naghma carries the meaning “Melody, Tune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naghma usually hope their child will grow to embody melody, tune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the beautiful recitation of the Quran and the melodic voice of Allah's Messenger (PBUH)

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naghma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
